MOUNTAIN

Summit climb. Waterfall descent. Lake bridge. Valley lights.

EXPERT
Format
Circuit · continuous laps
Length
≈ 3.84 km
Unlock
1,300 trophies · Expert Tracks

Read the route

Summit climb, waterfall descent, narrow lake bridge and valley lights.

Find time

Straighten before the bridge and make small corrections across it. Slow down before tight descents, then accelerate once the exit is clear.

Practise here

Build a clean lap before chasing a target time. OVERSIZED removes off-road slowdown, but does not remove walls or the need to follow the course.

Try Monster Truck and Steering.

Track goals

  • MOUNTAIN WINNER
  • MOUNTAIN SAFETY
  • MOUNTAIN DRIFT
  • MOUNTAIN FLOW
  • MOUNTAIN SPRINT

Exact requirements and trophy values: Achievements. Hidden discoveries are under its spoiler disclosure.
